question: What further role of nāda will be stated in the concluding verses of the kārikā?
premises: Nāda is under discussion as a principle of expression.
The text will later state that nāda produces cognition of the expressed.
This statement occurs in the concluding section.
inference: Nāda is also assigned the role of generating cognition of meaning.
plain_english: The kārikā will state in its conclusion that nāda too produces cognition of what is expressed.
